name: dna-helix-spectrum
description: Procedural rainbow DNA double helix with physically based depth of field (Three.js / WebGL 2 point-sprite bokeh renderer + HDR bloom pipeline).

scripts.render:v1: remotion render DNA-Helix-Spectrum-V1-Reference "out/Version 1 - DNA Helix Spectrum (Reference Match).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:v2: remotion render DNA-Helix-Spectrum-V2-Orbit-Camera "out/Version 2 - DNA Helix Spectrum (Orbit Camera).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:all: npm run render:v1 && npm run render:v2
